result.quote: So all the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces, and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
result.reason: Verse 11:18 directly and uniquely supports every part of the key. The wording clearly asks for the actions performed at Baal’s temple immediately following Jehoiada’s covenants, and the edit preserves the original intended fact and answer scope.
